  Cloud Computing [IT-4045]  
  Marks: 50                                                                              Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           A company "Manipal Infosystems" is considering migrating their IT infrastructure to the  
  cloud. What are the main types of cloud services they should consider for migration?  
  (5)  
  Explain.  
  A)  
  B)      A startup is looking to launch a new web application quickly and cost-effectively. How  
  can PaaS help them achieve this goal?                                                       (3)  
  
  C)      In a CIA Triad what do you mean by Integrity?                                               (2)  
  2)           In a cloud computing environment, four users (User D, User E, User F, and User G) are  
  submitting tasks to a shared resource pool. The system uses a fair queueing algorithm to  
  allocate resources. Each user submits tasks at different rates and requires different  
  A)      amounts of resources.  
  
  • User D submits tasks at a rate of 6 tasks per minute, each requiring 1.5 units of  
  resource.  
  • User E submits tasks at a rate of 4 tasks per minute, each requiring 2 units of  
  resource.  
  • User F submits tasks at a rate of 5 tasks per minute, each requiring 1 unit of  
  resource.  
  • User G submits tasks at a rate of 3 tasks per minute, each requiring 2.5 units of  
  resource.  
  (5)  
  The total available resource in the system is 25 units per minute. Based on the above  
  scenario the following questions:  
  
  1. Calculate the total resource demand per minute for each user.  
  2. Determine the fair share of resources each user should receive per minute based  
  on their demand and the total available resources.  
  3. Calculate the number of tasks each user can complete per minute with their fair  
  share of resources.  
  4. Evaluate the system's efficiency by comparing the total resource utilization with  
  the available resources.  
  
  
  .
